market_question: Will the No to ten million Switzerland initiative be approved in Switzerland’s June 14, 2026 popular vote?
reasoning: Early polls (e.g., Tamedia Dec 2024) showed Yes at ~42% and No at 54%. Historically, Swiss popular initiatives that threaten EU bilateral agreements lose support during campaigns; the similar 2020 limitation initiative failed with 38% after stronger initial polling. Given government and business opposition and the economic risk narrative, the probability of the initiative reaching both a popular and cantonal majority is below 33%, likely around 28%.
evidence_points: Tamedia poll (Dec 2024) showed 42% Yes, 54% No, with undecided tending to break against status‑quo change.
The 2020 limitation initiative—which also risked EU agreements—started above 40% in polls but fell to 38% in the final vote.
The Swiss Federal Council and a broad coalition of parties oppose the initiative, arguing it harms bilateral relations and the economy, a framing that historically moves voters.
